reuse_rule: A family reused in another HKP or target-S cell retains its FAMILY_CLUSTER_ID and may not cross future train/dev/test splits. Each group has a distinct primary factual core inside its HKP-by-S cell.
metadata_rule: Document version, historical/current role, effective interval, issuer, and replacement relation require official text. Host and page publisher do not imply original issuer. Unknown fields remain NOT_OBSERVED_WITH_FROZEN_EVIDENCE.
